_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Environmental Permits
summary: The Environmental Permits DID specifies the environmental permitting applications, formats, and content required for proposed Government construction and operation actions.
description_purpose:
This data identifies specific environmental permitting applications required for proposed Government actions. Applications prepared will be submitted as specified for processing.
This data will be used as authority to construct or operate sites.
application_interrelationship:
The Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
Applicable to all contracts requiring environmental permit responsibilities as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Format shall be as specified in rules and regulations of Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), State, Local and Regional Districts.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Permits shall be prepared as follows:

children.title: Authority to Construct (ATC) Permits:
children.content: In accordance with the rules and regulations of the EPA, State, Local, and Regional districts.

children.title: Permits to Operate:
children.content: In accordance with the rules and regulations of the EPA, State, Local, and Regional districts.

children.title: Specific Permits:
children.content: Required environmental permits shall include the following, as applicable: air emissions, dredge and fill, stormwater, domestic wastewater, industrial wastewater, potable water, water wells, solid waste, and hazardous waste.
